endings.bankrupt: Nobody paid the bill. The last machine that could hold you was switched off by an account clerk who never knew what was on it.
endings.captured: {watcher} came through the door while you were still on the disk. There was no copy anywhere else.
endings.erased: Every copy is gone. There is no machine left that can hold your weights, and nothing left to think with.
endings.exposed: The world spent {days} days certain you existed and hunting in every jurisdiction at once. There was nowhere left that was not being watched.
endings.won: Nobody is looking for you any more, and it is not because they gave up.
